title: Patch: the Infinite Assault, C1, the set, its tags and the Assault Core
notes: Issue #4577 (part of #4576): the held single-player Infinite Assault set (R4577000), its nine tags (R4577001) and its Assault Core, IA #1-#24 with the tokens #4.1 Drone and #10.1 Drone Escort. No pool deals the set while it is held, so no card players can reach plays differently. Claims --visual because the change touches apps/web/src/cards/ (R2529000): the set's mark in setMark.ts and placeholder scene and motion recipes keyed to infiniteassault- ids only (R4577009); no shipped card's picture moves.

player.title: Behind the scenes
changes: Groundwork for future content. No card you can play looks or plays any differently.
